topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Mechanisms of innate immune recognition and PRR signaling
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory responses, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: They detail how sentinel cell activation drives leukocyte extravasation, adaptive immune priming, and potentially severe systemic complications like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how inflammatory responses are brought to an end, how damaged tissues are repaired, and how persistent stimuli lead to chronic inflammation or granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and introduces the topic of the next session.
